title: NEXT Cube-IMG 7154.jpg
creator: Rama & Musée Bolo (Commons author field); photographer: Rama (Wikimedia Commons user)
original_date: 2014-11-14 (first upload to Wikimedia Commons by Rama; the file page gives the capture date as unknown)
capture_date_note: Not stated. The page's sponsor template reads "Musée Bolo (2013) - Supported by Wikimedia CH", which suggests a 2013 museum shoot, but that is not a capture date and is not recorded as one. The JPEG carries no camera EXIF (only Software = GIMP 2.8.14).
depicted_object_date_note: Object manufacture date not given by the source. NeXT cube hardware was sold 1988–1993.

identity_evidence.source_text: Description (template User:Rama/Bolo/NeXTcube): "NeXTcube workstation. On display at the Musée Bolo, EPFL, Lausanne."
identity_evidence.designation_limits: The source does not say whether the unit is the 1990 NeXTcube or the 1988 NeXT Computer, which share the cube enclosure. The label is kept exactly as "NeXTcube". Visible in frame, and not used as identity evidence: NeXT logo badges on the cube, display and mouse; a MegaPixel-style display; a French AZERTY NeXT keyboard.
identity_evidence.not_a_nextstation: The pictured machine is a cube; the NeXTstation is a flat pizza-box case.

original_format: JPEG, RGB, no ICC profile, no EXIF orientation tag
author_side_processing: The published file was saved with GIMP 2.8.14 and shows the equipment on a clean white ground; the background appears to have been isolated by the photographer. This is the author's own published version, not a change made by this production.
license_name: CC BY-SA 2.0 FR (author also offers CeCILL)
permission_evidence: Author's own license declaration on the file page: {{self|CeCILL|Cc-by-sa-2.0-fr}} (evidence/source-page.wikitext.txt); Commons API extmetadata LicenseShortName "CC BY-SA 2.0 fr" (evidence/commons-imageinfo.json).
credit_text: Photograph by Rama & Musée Bolo, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 2.0 FR (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.0/fr/). Framed for video (scaled, matted; no crop).
transformations: exports/editorial-frame.png: uniform scale to fit 1920x1080 and centred on a solid matte sampled from the photo's own border; no crop, stretch, retouching, text or UI. Exact parameters in evidence/framing.json.
